ws_before = wb['Before']

# Copy After sheet values into Before sheet for rows 1-12, cols A-B
for row in range(1, 13):
    for col in range(1, 3):
        val = ws_after.cell(row=row, column=col).value
        ws_before.cell(row=row, column=col).value = val

# Clear any remaining data in Before sheet rows 13-19
for row in range(13, 20):
    for col in range(1, 3):
        ws_before.cell(row=row, column=col).value = None

wb.save(out_path)
print('Done')
